block.factoriocore.belt.desc: Transports items at 15 items/s across two independent lanes.
block.factoriocore.fast_belt.desc: Transports items at 30 items/s across two independent lanes.
block.factoriocore.express_belt.desc: Transports items at 45 items/s across two independent lanes.
block.factoriocore.underground_belt.desc: Allows transport belts to cross obstacles underground (up to 5 blocks).
block.factoriocore.fast_underground_belt: Allows fast transport belts to cross obstacles underground (up to 7 blocks).
block.factoriocore.express_underground_b: Allows express transport belts to cross obstacles underground (up to 9 blocks).
block.factoriocore.splitter.desc: Splits and balances incoming belt lanes 1:1 with priority and item filtering.
block.factoriocore.fast_splitter.desc: Splits fast transport belt items at 30 items/s with priority and filtering.
block.factoriocore.express_splitter.desc: Splits express transport belt items at 45 items/s with priority and filtering.
block.factoriocore.burner_inserter.desc: Burns solid fuel to move items between belts and machines. Can refuel itself.
block.factoriocore.inserter.desc: Electric robotic arm that moves items between belts, chests, and machines.
Electric inserter that picks up and drops items 2 blocks away.
block.factoriocore.fast_inserter.desc: High-speed electric inserter for intensive production lines.
block.factoriocore.wooden_chest.desc: Stores up to 16 stacks of items.
block.factoriocore.iron_chest.desc: Stores up to 32 stacks of items.
block.factoriocore.steel_chest.desc: Stores up to 48 stacks of items.
block.factoriocore.pipe.desc: Transports fluids between pumps, boilers, tanks, and chemical machines.
block.factoriocore.pipe_to_ground.desc: Transfers fluids underground up to 10 blocks without blocking movement.
block.factoriocore.storage_tank.desc: Stores up to 25,000 mB of any fluid. Connects to pipes at its corners.
block.factoriocore.small_electric_pole.d: Basic wooden pole. Supply area: 5×5, wire reach: 7.5 blocks.
Steel distribution pole. Supply area: 7×7, wire reach: 9.0 blocks.
block.factoriocore.big_electric_pole.des: High-voltage transmission tower. Supply area: 4×4, wire reach: 30.0 blocks.
block.factoriocore.substation.desc: Wide-area power distribution grid node. Supply area: 18×18, wire reach: 18.0 blocks.
block.factoriocore.electric_energy_inter: Provides 500 MW of unlimited electricity to the connected network.
block.factoriocore.offshore_pump.desc: Pumps water from a lake shore at 1,200 mB/s without requiring electricity.
block.factoriocore.boiler.desc: Burns solid fuel to boil water into 165 °C steam proportional to demand.
block.factoriocore.steam_engine.desc: Consumes 165 °C steam to generate up to 900 kW of electricity.
block.factoriocore.solar_panel.desc: Produces up to 60 kW of clean electricity during daylight hours.
block.factoriocore.accumulator.desc: Stores up to 5.0 MJ of excess energy and provides up to 300 kW when needed.
block.factoriocore.burner_mining_drill.d: Burns fuel to mine ore in a 2×2 area and outputs it directly in front.
block.factoriocore.electric_mining_drill: Mines ore in a 5×5 area using electricity.
block.factoriocore.pumpjack.desc: Extracts crude oil from an oil deposit.
block.factoriocore.stone_furnace.desc: Smelts raw ores into plates and iron into steel using solid fuel.
block.factoriocore.steel_furnace.desc: Smelts ores twice as fast as a stone furnace using the same amount of fuel.
block.factoriocore.assembler.desc: Automatically crafts recipes containing up to 4 ingredients.
block.factoriocore.oil_refinery.desc: Processes crude oil into heavy oil, light oil, and petroleum gas.
block.factoriocore.chemical_plant.desc: Synthesizes plastics, sulfur, acids, batteries, explosives, and solid fuel.
block.factoriocore.lab.desc: Consumes science packs to research new technologies. [Shift+Right Click: Tech Tree]
block.factoriocore.landfill.desc: Placed on water to create buildable land. [Hold Shift for 3×3 brush]
block.factoriocore.stone_wall.desc: Heavy stone defensive barrier (350 HP) that blocks biters from jumping over.
block.factoriocore.gate.desc: Reinforced wall section that automatically opens when a player approaches.
block.factoriocore.land_mine.desc: Explodes when enemies approach, dealing area damage and stunning targets.
block.factoriocore.gun_turret.desc: Automatic defensive turret (range: 18 blocks). Loaded manually or via inserters.
block.factoriocore.laser_turret.desc: Long-range energy turret (range: 24 blocks) powered by the electric network.
block.factoriocore.flamethrower_turret.d: Incinerates enemies with a stream of burning oil (range: 26 blocks).
item.factoriocore.repair_pack.desc: Right-click a damaged machine or wall to repair it.
tooltip.factoriocore.grenade_desc_2: Clears trees and damages enemies without breaking factory blocks!
gui.factoriocore.chest_limit_tooltip: Limit inventory part to be filled by machines.

recipe.factoriocore.chem.1: Light oil cracking to petroleum gas

tech.factoriocore.gun_turret.desc: Automatic defensive turrets that can be fed magazines by inserters.
tech.factoriocore.fast_inserter.name: Fast Inserter
tech.factoriocore.fast_inserter.desc: Faster inserters powered by improved electronic circuits.
Unlocks green science packs for researching advanced logistics, power, and oil.
Unlocks military science packs for advanced weaponry and fortifications.

tech.factoriocore.logistics_2.name: Logistics 2
tech.factoriocore.logistics_2.desc: Faster transport belts, underground belts, and splitters (30 items/s).

tech.factoriocore.engine.desc: Converts fuel into mechanical motion. Essential for pumps and chemical science.
tech.factoriocore.electric_energy_distri: Medium and big steel electric poles for long-range power transmission.
tech.factoriocore.advanced_material_proc: Faster and more efficient steel furnaces for smelting ores.
tech.factoriocore.landfill.name: Landfill
tech.factoriocore.landfill.desc: Fills in water tiles with stone to expand buildable factory territory.
tech.factoriocore.gate.name: Gate
tech.factoriocore.gate.desc: Wall sections that automatically open as the player approaches.

tech.factoriocore.oil_processing.desc: Allows extracting crude oil with pumpjacks and refining it into petroleum gas.
tech.factoriocore.solar_energy.name: Solar Energy

tech.factoriocore.concrete.name: Concrete
tech.factoriocore.concrete.desc: Advanced paving material that boosts player movement speed.
tech.factoriocore.research_speed_1.name: Lab Research Speed 1

tech.factoriocore.plastics.name: Plastics
